edit.chronology: Natural forward motion: falling drop, impact/crown, rebound column, expanding ripples. No reversal or synthetic interpolation.
edit.preview_subsequent_loop: Natural forward playback from frame zero after the first end; no reverse playback.

poster_choice.selection: Dramatic still at edit time 4.6 seconds, selected after viewing both frame-zero and rebound-column versions in desktop and portrait.
poster_choice.reason: The column/drop is immediately legible for static, reduced-motion, data-saving or autoplay-blocked states. Frame zero is mostly empty dark water.
poster_choice.playback_caveat: These posters are not frame-zero matches. The preview controller plans to seek to edit time 4.6 seconds after metadata/seeked for the first entrance, then play forward to the end; later native loops restart at frame zero. This aligns the editorial cue approximately, not a certified pixel-exact poster/video-frame match.
poster_choice.alternate_start_posters_preserved: outputs/water-retired/water-start-desktop.jpg and water-start-mobile.jpg remain local; not copied into the four preview assets.
